channel.title: InYourBones Daily Music News
channel.description: Top 5 daily music stories handpicked by InYourBones

item.title: Elvis Presley Catalog Owners Sue AI Company Anthropic for Copyright Infringement
item.description: Elvis’s legacy deserves a little less “AI, thank you very much.” 🎸 His catalog owners are suing Anthropic over alleged copyright infringement.

item.title: Turnstile Draw 60,000 Fans to Washington Monument, Raise Over $220,000 for Humanitarian Aid
item.description: Turnstile brought 60,000 fans together at the Washington Monument—and raised over $220,000 for humanitarian aid. Punk with a powerful purpose ❤️🎸

item.title: Watch Jay-Z Bring Out Dr. Dre and Snoop Dogg at LA Tour Closer
item.description: LA got a West Coast dream team: Jay-Z brought out Dr. Dre and Snoop Dogg for a tour-closing moment worthy of a victory lap 🎤🔥

item.title: Drake Turns 40, Shares Personal Childhood Photos: ‘I Accept You for You’
item.description: Drake’s 40th birthday comes with a heartfelt look back at childhood—and a sweet message of self-acceptance 💙📸

item.title: Jay-Z Brings Out Blue Ivy, John Legend, DJ Khaled & Scarface in Los Angeles
item.description: LA got a legendary family affair 🎤 Jay-Z brought Blue Ivy, John Legend, DJ Khaled and Scarface to the stage! ✨
